spec.description: Performance and health metrics for your SQL Servers using windows Exporter v0.16 and Prometheus

panels.description: Shows Databse Health
panels.title: DATABASES HEALTH

panels.description:
**LOGICAL CONNECTIONS**

Number of logical connections to the system.

The main purpose of logical connections is to service multiple active result sets (MARS) requests. For MARS requests, every time that an application makes a connection to SQL Server, there may be more than one logical connection that corresponds to a physical connection.

When MARS is not used, the ratio between physical and logical connections is 1:1. Therefore, every time that an application makes a connection to SQL Server, logical connections will increase by 1.
panels.title: LOGICAL CONNECTIONS

Shows the total memory used by active SQL Server connections. This includes session context,

panels.description: Shows the number of SQL queries waiting for a memory grant

Shows the amount of memory SQL Server has taken ("stolen") from the buffer pool for

panels.description:
**Fetch | DLC Latency (ms)**

panels.title: Fetch | DLC Latency (ms)

panels.description:
**Peak | DLC Latency (ms)**

The largest recorded latency, in microseconds, of a fetch from the Direct Log Consumer by the XTP controller.
panels.title: Peak | DLC Latency (ms)

panels.description:
Shows the number of log cache misses in SQL Server. 
A cache miss occurs when required log data is not found in memory and must be fetched from disk.
